images.title: A prism on a 10 sided base
images.purpose: Shows a prism whose two congruent faces have 10 sides, with its faces, edges and vertices counted.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One upright prism in the centre, its counts in a short column on the right.
images.exact_structure: Centre: an upright prism drawn as a see through wire frame with thin lines, viewed slightly from above. Top face: a regular 10 sided polygon, all 10 edges drawn in teal #0072B2. Bottom face: the same 10 sided polygon, all 10 edges in teal (the back ones also solid, so all can be counted). 10 vertical edges in amber #E69F00 join each top vertex to the vertex below it. All 20 vertices marked with small reddish purple #CC79A7 dots. In all: 20 teal edges, 10 amber edges, 20 dots. Right side, a column of three short lines in dark text: '12 faces' with 'n + 2' in grey beside it, '30 edges' with '3n' in grey beside it, '20 vertices' with '2n' in grey beside it. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A 10 sided prism has 10 + 2 = 12 faces, 3 × 10 = 30 edges and 2 × 10 = 20 vertices.
images.description: Shows a prism whose two congruent faces have 10 sides, with its faces, edges and vertices counted.
images.context: Concept T6.C2; one image that shows only the main idea.

image_decisions.why: Counting parts of a solid needs the solid in view; colouring each edge family makes the count visible.
